generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The block handling `NotEquals` in the `rule` method appears to be dead code, as indicated by the accompanying comment stating that `!=` is already constructed as `NOT(==)`. If `NotEquals` nodes are not present in the AST at this stage of optimization, this logic should be removed to improve clarity.

The `matchesCase` method in `ChangeCase.Case` does not handle `null` values. In `ReplaceCaseWithInsensitiveMatch.replaceChangeCase`, the result of `bc.right().fold()` is converted to a string via `BytesRefs.toString()`, which can return `null`. If this happens, calling `matchesCase(foldedRight)` will trigger a `NullPointerException` when accessing `value.codePoints()`. Consider adding a null check at the beginning of `matchesCase` to return `false` if the input is null.

review_comment: As an alternative to avoid the pattern matching, use `Strings.deleteAny(input, " ")` or `Strings.replace(input, " ", "")`
The `\s` class will match more (`[ \t\n\x0B\f\r]`). I use it to compare (multiline, "randomly" spaced) JSONs.
